dms.title: Dead Man's Switch
dms.subtitle: If you stop checking in, your vaults are handed over to your Executor.

noExecutor.configured: No executor can receive the handover. Assign an executor.
noExecutor.notConfigured: Assign a primary executor before enabling the Dead Man's Switch.

dms.notSetUpHint: Choose your schedule on the right and save to turn it on.

vouch.body: {{name}} (trusted confirmer) confirmed you are safe at {{date}}, which counts as a check-in. A new check-in cycle has started.
vouch.countdown: Next check-in due in {{days}} d {{hours}} h {{minutes}} min.

dms.triggeredNote: The hand-over was triggered on {{date}}. Settings can no longer be changed.
dms.suspendedNote: Suspended by an administrator. Please contact support.
dms.noVaultScheduleHint: Create a vault first to change the schedule.
dms.noVaultNote: You have deleted all your vaults, so the Dead Man's Switch is paused: no reminders are sent and no hand-over will start. Create a new vault to start a new check-in cycle.

checkinIntervalDays.label: Check-in every (days)
checkinIntervalDays.hint: How often you need to confirm you are okay.

gracePeriodDays.label: Grace period (days)
gracePeriodDays.hint: Extra time after a missed check-in before hand-over starts.

reminderCount.label: Reminders
reminderCount.hint: Emails sent during the grace period.

dms.checkedIn: Checked in. We'll remind you before the next deadline.

pending.body: Your check-in and grace period expired. We have asked your Trusted Social Confirmers to verify your status before {{deadline}}. Click "{{button}}" to cancel immediately.

confirmers.title: Trusted Social Confirmers (Anti-False-Trigger)
confirmers.subtitle: Up to 2 trusted relatives/friends who will receive an emergency confirmation email (72h window) before your Executor is activated.
confirmers.empty: No trusted confirmers configured yet. Add up to 2 contacts below so accidental missed check-ins (e.g., travel or hospital stay) can be checked in for you by a confirmer.
confirmers.missingFields: Please enter both name and email for your trusted confirmer.

executors.title: Executors
executors.subtitle: Trusted people who handle the hand-over. They must have a verified LegacyVault account.

PRIMARY.title: Primary Executor
PRIMARY.text: Notified first when your Dead Man's Switch triggers.

BACKUP.title: Backup Executor
BACKUP.text: Takes over if the primary does not respond within 14 days.

executors.awaitingResponse: waiting for them to accept the invitation
executors.awaitingResponseUntil: waiting for them to accept, expires {{date}}
executors.revokeMessage: {{email}} will no longer be able to handle your hand-over.
